description:
Create a private, single-use link that signs the user straight into the right CapitalSnitch page — checkout
(card or crypto) to upgrade or renew, or their account page to cancel, change email settings or make a new
connection address. Valid 15 minutes, works once. Give it to the user to click; no password or email code
needed. Free to call.

action.description: upgrade/renew = checkout page; manage = account page (cancel, watchlist, email settings); new_connection_address = account page to replace a leaked address; briefing = today's briefing page.
